title: Uhealth - Jackson Urgent Care
address:
18910 South Dixie Highway
Cutler Bay, Florida 33157

description:
UHealth – Jackson Urgent Care is the first location to open under a partnership between Jackson Health System and the University of Miami Health System, bringing hospital-grade, non-emergency care to the community as an alternative to the ER. At 6,000 square feet, it's part of JHS's push to expand care closer to where patients live.

The layout leans on natural light and flexible seating — including high-top tables where visitors can work while they wait — to keep the waiting area bright and welcoming. Registration sits in a space designed to feel private while running on minimal staff, and it connects directly to the nursing work area behind it, so patients move from check-in to triage without delay.
